## Hi, I'm Sophia 👋

I came to data science because I had an empty spot in my schedule in my first semester at Willamette. 
Because of my interest in statistics, one of the Mathematics Professors suggested I try an introductory 
data science class. What keeps me interested in data science is the ability to draw real actionable 
insights from messy data. Though I enjoy all aspects of data pipelines, my highlights are the wrangling 
process and creating visualizations.

At Willamette my focus has been data engineering and data analysis. My capstone project, which analyzes 
WU Library's usage of their online resources(capstone.qmd), is where that comes together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🧶 I love to craft!
- 📚 My goal is to read 75 books in 2026.
- 🎯 In two years, I hope to be continuously honing and expanding my skills in the context of my industry.
